changelog.description:
Welcome to CodeOps Studio, our premier Android code editor. This initial release boasts an array of features designed to enhance your coding experience: 


Features:


- Robust text editing capabilities.


- Comprehensive syntax highlighting for over 50 major programming languages and 300+ file extensions and sub-language variants.


- Essential file management functionalities: create, open, save, and close files.


- Customizable theme options for the editor.


- Integrated search and replace functionality.


- Git repository cloning.


- In-app HTML preview and JavaScript console.


- Remote HTML preview for sharing via hotspot or internet.


- Multi-file support and universal file editor.


- Code formatting and importing of zip projects.- Singleton window system.


- Breadcrumbs file navigation.


- Access to recently opened projects and creation of projects from templates.


- Extensive code editor customization support, including default save file encoding and font ligatures.


- Integration with Material You design.


- Binary file detection and handling of unsupported file encodings.


- Logging support.


- Optimised features for improved productivity.


- Implemented automatic crash log collection to gather crash reports seamlessly.


- Utilized crash logs for continuous application improvement, ensuring stability and performance enhancements.




Known Issues:


- File tree manager optimization may be lacking, particularly noticeable on less powerful devices.


- Auto-completion window may not match the editor's theme.


- JavaScript console in the live preview pane may occasionally fail to load.


Contributors:  


- Main Developer: EUP https://x.com/euptron  


- Alpha Testers: 

 • Etido Asanga Henry https://x.com/AsangaEtid49822

 • Ike https://github.com/ike10101 



Thank you for choosing CodeOps Studio. We're committed to continually enhancing your coding journey.

We're excited to bring you the latest improvements and fixes in CodeOps Studio 1.0.1 beta! This release focuses on performance optimizations, enhanced compatibility, and several bug fixes.

Features:
- File tree refresh option.
- AST Core Module for better node management.
- Support for .apk file installation.
- Progress listener for case conversion.
- Improved symbol auto-completion.

Changes:
- Disabled code obfuscation and resource shrinking by proguard as it broke the last version.

Improvements:
- Optimized file tree loading and memory usage.
- Refactored code base for better maintainability.
- Optimized line text duplication and binary file detection.
- Enhanced crash handling.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed case conversion failure.
- Resolved multiple crashes related to null object references.
- Fixed issues with JavaScript engine initialization and fragment context attachment.

For the full changelog, visit https://github.com/euptron/CodeOps-Studio/CHANGELOG.md.

CodeOps Studio 1.0.2 beta brings key improvements and crucial fixes to streamline your development process. This update enhances performance, adds new input actions, and resolves several ongoing issues for a smoother and more reliable experience.

Features:
- Expanded the symbol input panel with additional actions.
- Revamped cursor movement actions to (MCR, MCL, MCU, MCD), where M = Move, C = Cursor, L = Left, R = Right, U = Up, and D = Down.

Changes:
- Improved storage permission logic.
- Initiated codebase restructuring for better scalability and maintainability.

Improvements:
- Refined permission handling for Android 11+ devices.
- Optimized document selection and file loading in LiveServer.
- Enhanced file loading efficiency within the LiveServer.
- Enhanced case conversion performance in the code editor.
- Various minor improvements for a more polished user experience.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed UI lag during LiveServer initialization.
- Resolved crashes when selecting files or folders, especially on newer Android versions.
- Addressed directory access crashes on Android 11+.
- Fixed storage permission request failures on Android 11+ devices.



With this release, CodeOps Studio continues to evolve, focusing on stability, performance, and overall user satisfaction. Thank you for your support and feedback. For a detailed changelog, visit for more insight https://github.com/euptron/CodeOps-Studio/CHANGELOG.md


~ EUP
